title: AOS-4 Independent Verification Foundation
description: Implement the generic deterministic independent-verification foundation. Introduce a verification-result contract and verifier boundary that consumes an existing ControlledExecutionResult and evidence metadata without executing or mutating the worker task. The verifier must produce PASS or HOLD-style verification output, must fail closed on malformed or contradictory evidence, and must not permit the executor result alone to authorize canonical closure. REMEDIATION REQUIREMENT: Any fixture/helper described or named as 'valid' MUST itself validate against the canonical schema present in the execution workspace. Specifically, the make_valid_descriptor() fixture used by the verification foundation tests MUST construct a project descriptor valid against canonical project_descriptor.schema.json (including required control keys: state, decisions, evidence, roadmap; and required authority keys: production_mutation, roadmap_change, destructive_data). Do NOT weaken project_descriptor schema, validation behavior, verifier fail-closed behavior, or required scenario expectations merely to make the test pass. Scenario 1 must PASS because its input fixture is genuinely canonical-valid, not because verification was weakened or bypassed. Preserve fail-closed semantics for malformed, stale, scope-invalid, missing-artifact, and contradictory inputs.
